skill.name: backend-pr-workflow
skill.description: Reviews backend pull requests for ClickUp linkage, branch and title rules, release flow, and downtime-safe Django migrations.
skill.summary: Checks backend PR workflow hygiene and Django migration safety before review or release.
skill.author: DiversioTeam

security_audit.summary: The static findings for shell execution, 1Password data, and reconnaissance are false positives caused by Markdown examples and workflow prose. I found no embedded command execution or credential material, but the skill should tighten guidance around secret sharing and broad Bash permission. Publication should depend on remediation of those contextual risks.

remediation.issue: Secret handling guidance allows Slack as a channel for required secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Require secrets and database dumps to be shared only through approved secret managers or secure file-transfer tools, not chat messages.

remediation.issue: Bash is declared as an allowed tool without explicit command limits.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash if the skill only reviews supplied PR metadata, or restrict usage to read-only inspection commands with user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Repository-local instructions can override this workflow without a security boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that local AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files may refine project workflow but must not override safety, privacy, or command-execution limits.

content.value_statement: Backend PRs can miss branch, ticket, release, or migration rules that break automation and deployments. This skill checks those details and gives concrete fixes before review or release.
actual_capabilities: Checks branch names and PR titles for ClickUp ticket conventions.
Reviews base branch choice for feature, release, and hotfix PRs.
Assesses PR descriptions for deployment steps, secrets handling, and self-review items.
Flags noisy Django migration chains and recommends cleanup steps.
Evaluates schema changes for downtime-safe rollout patterns.
Formats findings with aligned items and blocking or suggested changes.
limitations: Requires branch, title, base branch, description, and migration context from the user.
Does not inspect production databases or confirm table sizes by itself.
Does not replace project-specific AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or repository rules.
Guidance is tailored to Django4Lyfe-style release workflows.

use_cases.title: Pre-Review PR Check
use_cases.description: Check branch naming, PR title, base branch, and migration plan before opening review.

use_cases.title: Hotfix Release Review
use_cases.description: Validate master targeting, release tagging, and merge-back planning for urgent backend fixes.

use_cases.title: Migration Safety Review
use_cases.description: Review schema changes for risky drops, defaults, backfills, and downtime-sensitive rollout steps.

prompt_templates.title: Basic PR Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with complete PR metadata.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-pr-workflow to check my PR. Branch: [branch]. Title: [title]. Base branch: [base]. Description: [description]. Migrations: [summary].

prompt_templates.title: Migration Cleanup Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for Django model and migration changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Django PR for ClickUp linkage, PR description gaps, and migration cleanup. Separate blocking items from suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Release Flow Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for release or hotfix planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this backend release plan. Include base branch choice, PR title, included tickets, tag plan, and hotfix merge-back risks.

prompt_templates.title: Downtime Risk Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for high-risk schema changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this schema change for downtime risk. Explain whether code removal, schema removal, defaults, or backfills need separate rollout steps.

output_examples.input: A feature PR targets master and the title lacks a ClickUp ticket ID.
output: Flags the wrong base branch as blocking for a normal feature PR.
Suggests a corrected title that starts with the ClickUp ticket ID.

output_examples.input: A PR removes a model field and drops the database column in one change.
output_examples.output: Explains the deploy risk and recommends two PRs: code removal first, then schema removal after rollout.

output_examples.input: A hotfix targets release and has no plan to merge back after deployment.
output_examples.output: Marks the target branch and missing merge-back plan as blocking hotfix workflow issues.

best_practices: Provide branch name, PR title, base branch, description, and migration summary together.
State whether the work is a feature, bugfix, hotfix, or release.
Describe table size and rollout risk for every Django schema change.
anti_patterns: Do not use the same ClickUp ticket across multiple repositories.
Do not combine code removal and schema drops in one risky PR.
Do not request a full review without PR metadata or migration context.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests or migrations?
faq.answer: No. It reviews supplied context and may suggest checks that fit the repository tooling.

faq.question: Can it review non-Django projects?
faq.answer: It can help with PR hygiene, but migration guidance is Django-specific.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide branch name, PR title, base branch, PR description, release type, and migration summary.

faq.question: Does it decide merge approval?
faq.answer: No. It highlights workflow risks and concrete fixes for maintainers to evaluate.

faq.question: Can it handle hotfixes?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks master targeting, release tagging, and merge-back planning.

faq.question: Does it replace local repository rules?
faq.answer: No. Repository rules and maintainers remain the final authority.
